summary: Bug: Work Order can not be marked as completed if a part with core has been returned
reported_issue: On staging, a WO/line could not be marked complete when a part with a core had been returned (OK/Not OK not pressed for the core). Completion was blocked with: 'Line cant be completed with unfulfilled Core part. Please try to resolve this.' (Not reproducible on Production.)
expected_after_fix: The Work Order / line can be marked as complete even when a part with a core has been returned.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin. Identified approved WOs that have part return requests.
Opened WO S9-24171 (approved, 1 line, 3 part returns). Confirmed on the Parts tab it has a received part (2a339025) with a Core charge of 1.00.
Went to the Lines tab (line a07f785a status 'Approved'), selected the line, used bulk action -> Set line status -> Complete.
Observed the resulting line status and any error notification/dialog mentioning 'core'.
actual_now: The line was successfully set to 'Complete' with no error. No 'unfulfilled Core part' notification or dialog appeared (only an unrelated 'Build Lines' element was present). Completion of a line whose part carries a core, on a WO that has returns, succeeded. Corroborating: WOs S9-24176 (17 returns) and S9-24168 (14 returns) are already in 'ready_for_review', i.e. they were completed despite returned parts.
notes: The reported core-related completion block does not reproduce: a line with a core-bearing part completed cleanly on a WO with returns. Confidence is medium rather than high because I could not deterministically force the exact 'core OK/Not OK unpressed immediately after returning the main part' substate through the harness (the per-part receive/return/core-acknowledge controls are not fully drivable headless), but the completion path that the bug blocked now works with a core part + returns present.
